company_name: Fukuoka Prefectural semiconductor & Digital Industry Development Council
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The council plays a significant role in fostering the semiconductor industry within Fukuoka Prefecture by collaborating with various stakeholders to enhance technological capabilities.
summary: The Fukuoka Prefectural Semiconductor & Digital Industry Development Council is focused on advancing the semiconductor industry in Fukuoka Prefecture. It collaborates with approximately 400 companies and institutions to develop new technologies and industries, particularly in green devices and digital sectors like robotics and IoT. The council aims to strengthen the semiconductor supply chain and attract new companies to the region.
capabilities: Collaboration with semiconductor-related companies and institutions
Development of new technologies in green devices
Attraction of new companies to Fukuoka Prefecture

regional_presence.Japan: The council is dedicated to fostering the semiconductor industry within Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan, by enhancing technological capabilities and attracting new companies.
